title: Exterior tensor quotient is epimorphic
statement: Let A, B, C be sheaves of modules on a scheme X, and let g:B→C be an epimorphism. Using exterior sheaves and wedge sections [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], for any natural numbers r,s there exists an epimorphism q:(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s B)→(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s C), taking (∧a_i)⊗(∧c_j) to (∧a_i)⊗(∧g(c_j)) on every open.

proof.text: Construct a presheaf morphism by exteriorPower.map applied to each component of g. Check naturality on pure wedges using exteriorSheafRestriction_existsUnique, map_apply_ιMulti and naturality_apply. Sheafify the presheaf morphism; naturality of the adjunction unit computes its value on wedge sections. Tensor it with the identity on exteriorSheaf A r, obtaining q and its displayed formula via tensorHom_app_tmulSection.

To prove q epi, let phi and psi have equal composites with q. Evaluating this equality on a tensor of wedges of sections of A and B, and using the formula for q, proves equality on all lifted wedge generators. Apply exteriorTensor_lift_hom_ext to the epi g to get phi = psi. This is exactly the left-cancellation property defining Epi q.

lean.statement: theorem exteriorTensor_quotient_exists {X : Scheme.{v}} (A B C : X.Modules) (g : B ⟶ C) [Epi g] (r s : ℕ) : ∃ q : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf B s ⟶ exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf C s, Epi q ∧ ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin s → B.val.obj (op U)), q.val.app (op U) (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a) (exteriorSheafSection B s U c)) = tmulSection (M := exteriorSheaf A r) (N := exteriorSheaf C s) (exteriorSheafSection A r U a) (exteriorSheafSection C s U (fun i ↦ g.val.app (op U) (c i)))
